app.name: The PLACE Online
app.tagline: Help is closer than you think.
app.subtitle: The PLACE Online helps you understand documents, find resources, view classes, and connect with support from your phone.
app.inspiredBy: Online support inspired by The PLACE in Amarillo.
feature.document.title: Understand a Document
feature.document.desc: Take a photo or upload a letter, bill, or form and get a plain-English explanation.
feature.job.title: Find a Job
feature.job.desc: Get help with applications, resumes, and finding work in your community.
feature.bill.title: Pay a Bill
feature.bill.desc: Understand what you owe and learn options for paying or asking for help.
feature.classes.title: View Classes and Events
feature.classes.desc: See English classes, life skills, and community events near you.
disclaimer.compassion: The PLACE Online is here to help explain and guide. It does not replace legal, medical, financial, or government advice.
disclaimer.ai: AI can make mistakes. Always confirm important information with a person you trust.
disclaimer.upload: Do not upload private documents unless you are comfortable sharing them for help. This tool explains documents in plain language but does not provide legal, medical, financial, or government advice.

help.subtitle: Choose the option that sounds closest to what you need. You can change your answer anytime.
